outputs.prompt: Create a production game art atlas matching the attached APPROVED dungeon exploration UI. The input is a STYLE AND LOCATION reference; do not copy the screen layout. Eight isolated alpha cutouts in FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows, each in its own cell with generous transparent gutters. No labels or grid. Row 1 cells 1..4: stone dungeon stair entrance; vaulted Sentry Hall with arched corridors; Broken Vault with fallen masonry; Flooded Cells with iron bars and shallow water. Row 2 cells 1..4: Watch Post with stone benches and torch; Lower Gate with receding archway; Sealed Crypt with ornate locked stone door; a small crimson wax seal with an iron gate and hanging lantern. Seven complete painted oblique location vignettes plus ONE SMALL identity seal. Coherent perspective, scale, subdued dark fantasy paint, ashen stone, old architecture or vegetation and restrained amber light EXACTLY like the reference. Each place needs an organic ground silhouette that ends in genuine transparent alpha. Do not add a broad opaque backdrop, cloudy glow, rectangle, matte, fake checkerboard, drawn routes, parchment slips, text, letters, numerals, UI buttons, people or watermarks. Avoid shadows in the gutters. Every location should be legible at about 200x140 screen pixels. Empty sheet area MUST be fully transparent alpha=0, including all four corners.
